claims.statement: The category is normalized monic-centered Jacobian-minus-one Henon maps over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field.
On the length-2m fixed scheme, q is nilpotent with q squared zero and the formal multiplication spectrum is zero with multiplicity 2m.
The formal exact-period-two trace multiset is 2 with multiplicity (2m)^2-2m, retaining the nilpotent correction before diagonal subtraction.
Within normalized moduli, f_(m,a) and f_(m,b) are conjugate exactly when a^(2m-1)=b^(2m-1).
The cyclic equations at epsilon one encode Fix(f^3), and their Jacobian determinant is q0 q1 q2 plus epsilon squared times q0+q1+q2.
The cyclic quotient is monic free of rank (2m)^3 over the parameter ring.
The moment S_m equals the quotient trace of t_epsilon^m and the global residue of t_epsilon^(m+1).
Weighted homogeneity initially permits exactly four parameter monomials in S_m.
The coefficient of a^(3(2m-1)) vanishes by the separated epsilon-zero algebra and nilpotence.
The coefficient of a^(2(2m-1)) epsilon^m vanishes after the three nonfixed Puiseux patterns and the separate exact diagonal branch.
For every m at least two, S_m(a,epsilon)=C_m epsilon^(3m)+D_m a^(2m-1) epsilon^(2m).
C_m is zero for odd m by cyclic reversal.
The displayed finite nested-binomial H/A/D expression equals D_m for every m at least two, including the separate j=0 flow.
The fixed contribution to the formal period-three m-th trace moment is zero.
Every normalized monic-centered quartic with formal fixed-point trace multiset zero to multiplicity four has p=(x^2-L)^2.
On the quartic fiber, the pointwise exact-period-three second trace moment is -1296000-1572864 L^3.
The formal exact-period-three pointwise length is 60 and the cyclewise moment is -432000-524288 L^3, after a separate local fixed-branch multiplicity proof.
Period three is the minimal conjugacy separator on the complete normalized quartic fiber with formal fixed-point trace multiset zero to multiplicity four.

The complete normalized quartic fiber is p=(x^2-L)^2; periods one and two are blind, while the exact-period-three moment is affine with nonzero L^3 slope and separates normalized conjugacy classes minimally.
For every symbolic m at least two, the two-term law, odd-m parity, and finite slope certificate hold; universal slope nonvanishing is not included.

nonclaims.statement: Period three is not claimed to separate all quartic Henon maps.
No global degree-four period cutoff P(4)=3 is claimed.
